async function ungzip(name){const spec=M.assets[name],txt=document.getElementById('data-'+name).textContent.trim(),bin=Uint8Array.from(atob(txt),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)),raw=await new Response(new Blob([bin]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).arrayBuffer();if(raw.byteLength!==spec.rawBytes)throw Error(name+' 字节数不匹配');if(await digest(raw)!==spec.sha256)throw Error(name+' SHA-256 不匹配');loadCount++;window.SMI_BOOT.loaded=loadCount;$('loadTitle').textContent='读取真实数据 '+loadCount+'/'+window.SMI_BOOT.total;$('loadBar').style.width=(loadCount/window.SMI_BOOT.total*100)+'%';$('loadDetail').textContent=name;return raw}

async function load(){const names=Object.keys(M.assets);for(const n of names){const raw=await ungzip(n);const dt=M.assets[n].dtype;if(dt==='f32')S[n]=new Float32Array(raw);else if(dt==='u8')S[n]=new Uint8Array(raw);else if(dt==='packed_dem')S[n]=unpackDem(raw);else if(dt==='json')S[n]=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(raw))}initGL();bindUI();resize();draw();updateQuery();info.textContent='构建 '+M.build+'\nCRS '+M.crs+'\n核心 DEM: '+M.assets.core_dem.shape.join('×')+' @12.5 m\n背景 DEM: '+M.assets.context_dem.shape.join('×')+' @25 m\n海底证据格网: '+M.assets.bathy_f32.shape.join('×')+'\n测深点: '+S.soundings.points.length+'\n礁盘分类: 1024×1024\n\n所有内嵌数据已逐项 SHA-256 校验。';window.SMI_BOOT.state='ready';window.SMI_BOOT.firstFrame=true;loading.style.display='none';status.innerHTML='<span class="good">真实数据已加载。</span> 三维首帧完成；候选海底默认隐藏。'}
